findings.title: Cache is not rechecked after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: In GetWebAssets, the cache pointer is checked under RLock, the read lock is released, and then the write lock is acquired without rechecking entryPointAssetsCache. In non-dev mode, multiple concurrent requests during a cold start can all observe a nil cache and proceed past the early return. After one goroutine populates the cache, the others will still reload the manifest and then unconditionally assign entryPointAssetsCache = result. This causes redundant I/O while holding the mutex and, if one of those later reloads fails, it can overwrite a freshly populated valid cache with nil. The code should recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock and return the existing value when appropriate, or use sync.Once/singleflight for initialization.
